# Switch

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:switch` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

An on/off setting that applies immediately: a native checkbox with role="switch" drawn as a track and thumb beside its label, with a hint on the label's column.

## When to use

Turn a setting on or off the moment it changes, such as live updates or a preference, without Web Awesome.

- A setting takes effect immediately when toggled, in a settings list or a pane footer.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for an option a form submits later; use Checkbox.
- Do not use for an icon-only toolbar toggle; use IconToggleButton or a ToolbarControlGroup toggle.

**Alternatives:**

- [Switch](./wa-switch.md) (prefer-over)
- [Checkbox](./checkbox.md) (nearest) — Use Checkbox for an option a form submits.
- [IconToggleButton](./icon-toggle-button.md) (nearest) — Use IconToggleButton for an icon-only toggle.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/switch` — exports `Switch`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/switch` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/switch.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/switch`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiswitch) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- on or off
- hint
- disabled
- default or compact size

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** checked state; applying the setting.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: none (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- A 35×20 track (31.5×18 compact) 8px (7px) before its label; the hint aligns with the label text.

## Accessibility

- A native \<input type="checkbox" role="switch"> inside its \<label>, invisibly over the drawn track, so the label names it and assistive technology announces on or off; Space toggles it and focus shows the focus ring on the track. The hint is its aria-description. The thumb's slide is skipped when reduced motion is preferred.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-switch`, `kui-switch__row`, `kui-switch__control`, `kui-switch__input`, `kui-switch__track`, `kui-switch__thumb`, `kui-switch__label`, `kui-switch__hint`.

Never put `kui-switch`, `kui-switch__row`, `kui-switch__control`, `kui-switch__input`, `kui-switch__track`, `kui-switch__thumb`, `kui-switch__label`, `kui-switch__hint` on an element you write; render `Switch` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-brand-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-surface`, `--kui-color-text`, `--kui-color-text-quiet`, `--kui-focus-ring`, `--kui-font-m`, `--kui-font-s`, `--kui-font-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
